scope: Navigation target metadata only, not an assertion about the missing 1915 print folios

decisions.rationale: Digital visible label is unambiguous (Judges 1:27) while the encoded target points to Revelation 1:2. Two publicly readable ISBE transcriptions agree on Judges 1:27. The missing 1915 Cornell facsimile folios 2887-2888 remain unverified; this change corrects navigation only and makes no claim of print collation. The separate MEGIDDO article has an image-attested equivalent reference target (1915 volume III page 671), establishing the displayed abbreviated book-code mapping only, not the wording of TAANACH.
